fullTextZH: 你好！今天我要说一个故事
fullTextEN: Hello! Today I want to tell a story.

fullTextZH: 叫“如果你给老鼠吃饼干。”
fullTextEN: Called 'If You Give a Mouse a Cookie.'
One day I was reading, yes,

fullTextZH: 所以我要吃饼干。对，饼干，
fullTextEN: So I want to eat cookies. Yes, cookies,

fullTextZH: 你的饼干看起来很好吃，
你可以给我一块饼干吗？”
fullTextEN: Can you give me a cookie?
So I gave him a cookie

fullTextZH: 你可以给我一杯牛奶吗？”
fullTextEN: Can you give me a glass of milk?"

fullTextZH: 我觉得这只老鼠有一点点麻烦(troublesome/annoying) ，
fullTextEN: I think this mouse is a little troublesome,

fullTextZH: 我的家里有很多很多牛奶，
fullTextEN: There is a lot of milk in my house,

fullTextZH: 可是我的家里有很多很多猫，
fullTextEN: But there are many cats in my house,
So I took him to my house,
Then I gave him a glass of milk.
But he can't drink it. Right,
because the cup is very big

fullTextZH: 你可以给我一根吸管吗？
fullTextEN: Can you give me a straw?
So I gave him a straw,
Ah~, the milk is really delicious,

fullTextZH: 为什么我的嘴巴都是牛奶？
fullTextEN: Why is my mouth all milk?

fullTextZH: 你可以给我一张纸擦擦嘴吗？”
fullTextEN: Can you give me a tissue to wipe my mouth?
So I gave him a tissue,
because he wanted to wipe his mouth.

fullTextZH: 他说：，“嗯～我觉得我的嘴巴还是有牛奶，
fullTextEN: he said, "Hmm~ I think my mouth still has milk,

fullTextZH: 你可以带我去照照镜子(look in the mirror)吗？”
fullTextEN: Can you take me to look in the mirror?
So I took him to look in the mirror,

fullTextZH: 你可以给我一把剪刀吗？”
fullTextEN: Can you give me a pair of scissors?
I gave him a pair of scissors,
Ah~ here is all my hair,
I think we should clean up."
So he and I cleaned up together.

fullTextZH: 打扫以后他说：“啊！好累啊，
fullTextEN: After cleaning, he said, "Ah! So tired,
So I took him to sleep,
When he was sleeping, he said, "
I want to hear a story,

fullTextZH: 我的妈妈每天给我讲一个故事。”
fullTextEN: My mom tells me a story every day.
So I go to get the book,
he said, "Hmm, you didn't tell it well,
I want to read by myself."
So I give him the book,
I give him many, many pens,
He drew all the family members.
He said, 'Hmm~ it's drawn really well,
I think I should put the drawing

fullTextZH: 贴在(stick to)冰箱上(on the fridge)。”
所以他画完以后我们把画贴在冰箱上。
fullTextEN: So after he finished drawing, we put the drawing on the fridge.

fullTextZH: 叫“如果你给老鼠一块饼干”
fullTextEN: called 'If You Give a Mouse a Cookie'

fullTextZH: 我觉得这个故事很可爱
fullTextEN: I think this story is very cute
I hope you like it too.
